mana_diagnostics.interpretation: Native construction heuristic; lower risk is preferred. This is not an EDHPowerLevel percentage or a playtest result.

construction.score_explanation: The search links Rograkh’s resource roles to Silas’s attack and artifact replays.

synergy.summary: Put Rograkh to work early, get Silas through blockers, and replay artifacts to build a board that can close the game.

highlights.title: Put Rograkh to work early
highlights.description: Rograkh costs zero on the first cast. Tap him to help pay for Silas, or keep him around to enable a commander spell. Once you have enough mana, you can sacrifice him to draw cards. Look for Springleaf Drum, Relic of Legends, Deadly Dispute.

highlights.title: Connect with Silas
highlights.description: Get a worthwhile artifact into your graveyard before combat and give Silas a path past blockers. After he hits a player, you can cast the chosen artifact that turn if you can pay its cost. Look for Thieves' Tools, Whispersilk Cloak.

highlights.title: Keep reusing artifacts
highlights.description: Replay cheap artifacts for cards and removal. Use additional recursion to keep the engine going when Silas can’t connect. Look for Aether Spellbomb, Pyrite Spellbomb, Emry, Lurker of the Loch.

highlights.title: Turn the artifact board into damage
highlights.description: Repeated artifact entries and sacrifices wear down opponents. When you have a large board, turn it into attackers or use a payoff that scales with the artifact count. Look for Reckless Fireweaver, Oni-Cult Anvil, Rise and Shine.

synergy.model: A neural ranker learns card fit from Oracle text, card characteristics, and collected lists. The pair’s optimizer checks what Rograkh can pay for, which artifacts Silas can replay, and what helps Silas connect.
